page.content:
Dominant center of the three-peat Lakers.

How Shaquille O'Neal connects

  • Faction: Los Angeles Lakers — Shaquille O'Neal was the dominant center of the three-peat Lakers.
  • Faction: Miami Heat — Shaquille O'Neal later won a title with the Miami Heat.

What is Shaquille O'Neal?

Shaquille O'Neal was the unguardable center of the 2000–02 Los Angeles Lakers, an MVP Finals force whose later Heat title added a third franchise to his ring count.

Key threads lead to Los Angeles Lakers and Miami Heat.
